title.narrative: Wahid Foundation Peace Village Supporting a Resilient Community through Strengthening Farmer’s Capacities in Climate Action

description.narrative: Increase community resilience against climate-related impacts through enhancing village communities’ capacity about climate change causes, impacts and ways to address them.

The project aims to address climate vulnerability and enhance resilience in Banyuwangi and Sumenep, two regions in East Java, Indonesia, highly affected by extreme weather events such as droughts and typhoons. The project aims to enhance resilience of village communities and improve ecosystems through circular farming and social and human capitals by: 1) Increased community capacity on circular farming, integrating livestock and vegetables to unproductive land in selected villages contributing to increase resilience against climate change adversities, and 2) The development of alternative sources of income for women's groups to enhance their resilience against climate change effects.
